prompt_text: Which title company in St. Louis MO is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” title company—the right choice depends on your property’s location, closing date, fees, and how responsive the team is. **For a strong starting point, I’d compare Title Resources Inc. and Investors Title Company.**

- **Title Resources Inc.** reports a 5.0 Google rating from 92 reviews and handles residential purchases, sales, and refinances. Its reviews highlight clear communication and smooth closings.
- **Investors Title Company** has more than 20 offices across the St. Louis area, plus in-house attorneys and in-person or mobile closing options—useful if convenience or a complicated title issue matters.

Also consider **Community Title Services**, which reports 115+ five-star Google reviews, and **Freedom Title**, which advertises evening and Saturday closings.

Before choosing, ask for a written estimate of title and settlement fees, confirm the office or mobile-closing options, and check that your lender can work with the company. Your purchase contract may also specify how the title company is selected.
